entities.name: Üüreg Lake
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Üüreg Lake is a saline lake in an endorheic basin in Sagil, Uvs Province, Mongolia, north-west of the Great Lakes Hollow, near the western edge of the Uvs Nuur basin. The Tsagaan river gorge lies on the west side of the lake.
